keyword.zh: 电动80和LZ-80混凝土泵的区别

title.zh: 电动80和LZ-80混凝土泵有何不同

description.en: The shared 80 is not a shared output. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h. LZ-80 prints ≤ 65 m³/h and ≤ 95 m³/h on two pressure lines.
description.zh: 名称里的 80 不是同一个产量。电动80印 60 m³/h。LZ-80 在两档压力下印 ≤ 65 m³/h 和 ≤ 95 m³/h。

h1.zh: 电动80和LZ-80混凝土泵有何不同

directAnswer.en: Electric 80 and LZ-80 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric 80 prints a 110 kW motor, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa and distance 900 m / 300 m, with aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). LZ-80 prints a 256 kW Yuchai diesel, high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h at ≤ 35 MPa, low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h at ≤ 22 MPa, and aggregate 6 cm and below. The numeral 80 does not equal either output cell.
directAnswer.zh: 电动80和 LZ-80 是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。电动80印 110 kW 电机、60 m³/h、40 MPa、距离 900 m / 300 m，骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。LZ-80 印玉柴柴油机 256 kW，高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、≤ 35 MPa，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h、≤ 22 MPa，骨料 6 cm 及以下。数字 80 不等于其中任何一个产量格。

heading.en: Where Electric 80 and LZ-80 print different values

body.en: Theoretical output: Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h; LZ-80 prints High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Hopper capacity: Electric 80 prints 0.7 m³; LZ-80 prints 0.6 m³. Max. aggregate size: Electric 80 prints 24 mm (≤ 2 cm); LZ-80 prints 6 cm and below. Hydraulic pump: Electric 80 prints Kawasaki 140 double pump; LZ-80 prints Kawasaki double 140. Dimensions: Electric 80 prints 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm; LZ-80 prints 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：电动80印 60 m³/h；LZ-80印 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。料斗容积：电动80印 0.7 m³；LZ-80印 0.6 m³。最大骨料粒径：电动80印 24 mm (≤ 2 cm)；LZ-80印 6 cm and below。液压泵：电动80印 Kawasaki 140 double pump；LZ-80印 Kawasaki double 140。外形尺寸：电动80印 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm；LZ-80印 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Electric 80 prints cells that LZ-80 does not: Model line Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110; Motor power 110 kW; Max. outlet pressure 40 MPa; Pumping distance (H / V) 900 m / 300 m; Main unit weight 6000 kg. LZ-80 prints cells that Electric 80 does not: Engine (diesel) 256 kW (Yuchai); Pumping pressure High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; Conveying distance 120 m; Delivery height Consult factory standard; Total weight 6800 kg. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 电动80有、LZ-80没有的行：型号行 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110；电机功率 110 kW；最大出口压力 40 MPa；输送距离（水平/垂直） 900 m / 300 m；整机重量 6000 kg。LZ-80有、电动80没有的行：柴油发动机 256 kW (Yuchai)；泵送压力 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa；输送距离 120 m；输送高度 Consult factory standard；整机重量 6800 kg。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Aggregate wording also differs: 24 mm (≤ 2 cm) on one page, 6 cm and below on the other. Open /en/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/ for Electric 80 and /en/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-80. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 骨料写法也不同：一页是 24 mm（≤ 2 cm），另一页是 6 cm 及以下。看电动80请打开 /zh/products/electric-80-concrete-pump/，看LZ-80请打开 /zh/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Electric 80 print the same theoretical output as LZ-80?
question.zh: 电动80和LZ-80的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints 60 m³/h. LZ-80 prints High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动80印 60 m³/h。LZ-80印 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 80 print the same hopper capacity as LZ-80?
question.zh: 电动80和LZ-80的料斗容积一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints 0.7 m³. LZ-80 prints 0.6 m³. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动80印 0.7 m³。LZ-80印 0.6 m³。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Electric 80 print the same max. aggregate size as LZ-80?
question.zh: 电动80和LZ-80的最大骨料粒径一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 prints 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). LZ-80 prints 6 cm and below. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动80印 24 mm (≤ 2 cm)。LZ-80印 6 cm and below。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is model line missing on LZ-80?

answer.en: The LZ-80 page does not print that label. Electric 80 prints Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: LZ-80这一页没有印这个标题。电动80印的是 Electric 80 / HBT80-1816-110。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
